particle_mapping.additional_tags: H3-mapped PARTICLE tags not in the prespecified groups are OTHER_PARTICLE; unrecognized tags are UNMAPPED_PARTICLE and retained in audits.
particle_mapping.source: H3 tag_to_coarse_group from saved h3_pos_mapping.json; exact particle fine POS retained.

population: H2/E2 eligible population, saved H3 NOMINAL_TO_PARTICLE; CROSS exactly one boundary; SPLIT uses exact H3 nearest-adjacent boundary rule
span_validation: Exact H2 token spans are intersected with H3 Kiwi full morpheme spans; H3 crossed POS sequence and local split assignment are independently checked. Unverifiable rows are listed and excluded from H4 feature models.

formulas.H4a: rejection ~ morph_class * particle_category + fragmentation FE + E2 structural + entropy + bs(log_token_count, df=4, degree=3, include_intercept=False)
formulas.H4b: CROSS-only rejection ~ geometry class + particle category + nominal POS + H3 M5 controls; continuous coverage model includes nominal fraction * particle fraction
formulas.L2: L1 + particle category + nominal POS + nominal/particle surface lengths; H3 eojeol_char_length is retained because it is the identical eojeol surface length measure
formulas.L3: L2 + cubic 4-df splines of log nominal, particle, and eojeol frequency

references.particle_category: CASE_SUBJECT where supported; otherwise first prespecified level with both classes
references.geometry_class: most-supported observed geometry, chosen by support only

uncertainty: prompt-clustered covariance and delta-method adjusted probabilities/AMEs; two-sided tests
multiple_testing: Holm across all seven prespecified particle categories within each pair; non-estimable/unsupported categories enter as p=1

support_thresholds.warn: class count <100 or class prompt count <50

matching.method: coarsened exact matching; 1:1 without replacement inside strata; clustered LPM with stratum FE

execution: CPU analysis only; no GPU, weights, target generation, speculative decoding, or teacher-forced scoring
